findings.title: Do not claim an available posting balance from a deposit ID
findings.scenario: readAccountStatus returns fee-ready when private fee credit is positive and get_deposit_ids contains any nonzero ID. It deliberately returns postEligibility requires-action-simulation; no available deposit balance or eligibility has been checked. A penalized or otherwise unusable retained deposit can therefore display Your posting balance is available before action checks.
findings.recommendation: Use plain factual copy such as A posting deposit was found. We will check whether it can be used when you review an action. Keep authoritative action simulation unchanged. Add a UI assertion that discovery-only status does not assert available balance or eligibility.

otherChecks: Inspected three changed paths before worker outcome. Other text substitutions preserve private recovery complete/partial status, explicit no transaction for read recovery, and confirmation requirement for writes.
Exact maximum network fee amount, maximum-not-final-charge statement, explicit Confirm and send, unknown-outcome/no-resend wording and encrypted preference-update fee disclosure unchanged.
Tests alter exact expected text and retain existing counter/partial/account-invalidation assertions; no assertion suppression found. Browser slot belongs to design; reviewer did not run browser.
limits: Source-only copy disposition; no real-chain browser or final exact UI runtime qualification.
